extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and patent examiners (U.S. practice)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance (MPEP Chapter 600) on required parts, form, and content of U.S. provisional and nonprovisional patent applications, including specifications, claims, drawings, oaths/declarations, ADS, IDS, and related procedural matters. Intended to direct preparation and examination of application materials under U.S. patent law.
